scope: Process-opt-in host lookup retention with conservative failed-native guard; no ACK or graceful-refusal implementation

host_validation.baseline_header_caveat: Baseline import/detach bodies compile with candidate append-only marker field solely for common fixture inspection; regression fails on original lookup loss before marker logic.
scenarios: Cache/list success and already-typed duplicate/changed-argument call retaining original authoritative type
Opaque native refusal, no repeated driver call, token-disable cannot bypass guard
Hidden pending NULL duplicate survives original teardown
Texture-import failure cleanup with retired or retained native duplicate
Hash insertion refusal rejects same/changed metadata retries and retains completed pipe until teardown
Cross-context promotion then stale untyped detach, and promoted-resource registration failure rejects retries
Invalid FD type, unsupported format, missing resource and invalid plane count
Real original FD close once plus reused-FD sentinel survives destructor
Actual public pipe, FD and opaque factories initialize marker to zero
host_validation.quarantine_scope: Mock quarantine roots/FDs are retained until subprocess exit; no raw pointer retry/reclamation. Actual D93 bridge source is hash-pinned and unchanged, not exercised against a real GPU.

behavior.untyped_lookup: With exact token, retain original cache/list record until successful context registration. It is nonowning; global virgl_resource continues owning original FD or completed pipe_resource.
behavior.pre_native_failure: Constructor/format/FD validation can return with original ownership and no native attempt. Existing decoder errors are unchanged; direct function test retries do not qualify operational retries through the decoder.
behavior.opaque_native_failure: Set resource guard before either bridge or ordinary EGL import. Every failure after entry, including indistinguishable preallocation NULL, keeps guard; further staged requests cannot invoke native import. Guard is checked even with opt-in subsequently disabled.
behavior.context_hash_failure: Keep or set guard after every failed opt-in hash registration, including an already-promoted shared pipe. Original FD is closed/invalidated on native promotion; global pipe_resource remains owned until teardown. Retained untyped lookups cannot enable later registration-only retries with either original or changed metadata.
behavior.successful_commit: Verify context hash lookup equals completed pipe before removing retained entry and clearing guard. Existing already-typed calls return success without reimport or accepting/changing new metadata; this preserves legacy authoritative-type attachment semantics and is not immutable transaction acknowledgement.
behavior.detach: Remove all matching nonowning cache/list records regardless of shared pipe state, including another context promotion and duplicate attachments; remove typed hash entry when present. This cleanup correction also applies with opt-in disabled.
behavior.legacy: Without exact token and absent an earlier marked resource, original consume-before-import behavior remains. No new native retry, errno rewriting, dummy resource, context-error clearing, waits or native cleanup calls.

initialization_proof.base_constructor: virgl_resource_create uses calloc(1,sizeof(*res)); marker starts zero
initialization_proof.header_change: Append uint8_t vrend_native_import_blocked after existing fields; existing fields not reordered
initialization_proof.build_requirement: All renderer translation units/consumers of internal virgl_resource layout need a matched rebuild against this header. Internal ABI/build compatibility is not established by helper tests.
initialization_proof.factory_test_scope: All three actual public factory bodies compile against the actual patched header and execute in host tests; zero-initialized marker is asserted. FD factory also supplies every standard scenario resource.

ownership_proof.failure_original_fd: Unchanged set_type failure branches neither close nor transfer original resource FD. Actual global destructor still closes valid FD exactly once after context detach.
ownership_proof.pending_backing: Unchanged D93 bridge independently duplicates sync/import FDs; successful Vulkan FD import consumes its owned duplicate. Pending destroy returns before FD/native cleanup, retaining backing. Original resource teardown does not own or reclaim those duplicate/native references.
ownership_proof.cleanup_order: Global virgl_renderer_resource_unref detaches contexts before global resource removal. Candidate detach must clear stale untyped pointers even after shared pipe promotion.
ownership_proof.scope: Source proof and host stand-ins only. No physical GPU retirement, concurrency or producer-write synchronization proof.

thread_contract: Existing serialized GL-owner/reference contract; retained list pointer may not be concurrently detached or mutated during import. No new concurrency support, lock, thread or driver callback contract is introduced.
limitations: No ACK, graceful expected refusal, client-local failure recovery or compositor presentation qualification. Existing EINVAL/sticky decoder error behavior remains.
Opaque bridge NULL cannot distinguish admission refusal from pending native failure, so both are conservatively blocked against native retry.
Guard is per global virgl_resource, not per underlying DMA-BUF alias. It does not establish safe producer writes, cross-resource alias reuse or general post-fault recovery.
Unchanged native quarantine may retain duplicate/native backing until process exit; this patch neither tracks, retries nor reclaims it.
Existing attach path can drop an older untyped lookup when allocating its wrapper fails. This candidate preserves ownership during set_type staging, not across arbitrary attach OOM.
Context-hash insertion is verified only for opt-in staging. A failed insertion keeps a globally completed pipe, not an original FD rollback.
Default detach additionally clears stale/duplicate nonowning records. Active import behavior without opt-in otherwise remains legacy.

Actual extracted import/detach/global constructor/destructor and all three public factory functions compile with the actual patched header in helper tests; GL/EGL, hash tables and native quarantine are stand-ins.
Full renderer/internal ABI and installed binary equivalence are unverified; do not enable or package without separate review/build/runtime qualification.
An already-typed duplicate SET_TYPE still returns legacy success while ignoring changed metadata; this source candidate provides no per-request immutable ACK contract.
